overview: This enum selects the character-specific computer AI profile used when the game controls a fighter.

None.simple: The empty AI profile used when a character row has no AI type.

Invalid.simple: The reserved AI profile used for an out-of-range stored byte.
Invalid.technical: BrainInit86 installs FGameCharacterAIThinkNode_CP_010 and BrainCreate95 installs UGameCharacterBehaviorController. This value has no explicit case in either switch and follows the default arms.

notes: CharacterDataTable stores this value in AIType at row offset 0xA9, and CreateBrain passes that byte to BrainInit86 when the explicit override byte is 255.
The think-node switch and the behavior-controller switch have different case sets, so several profiles receive a custom think node with the base behavior controller.
CN_170 receives the default CP_010 think node and a dedicated UCN_170_BehaviorController.
The header declares no enumerators from 47 through 254, and Invalid is the declared sentinel at 255.
